_description: Fixtures for ADMISSIBLE_NARROW_FIX_CURSOR_NDJSON_TERMINAL_EVENT_CAPTURE. cli_005_live_failure_replay is the sanitized metadata from the real Cursor one-shot invocation cited in the task brief (managed process completed cleanly, exit 0, stderr empty, but the NDJSON terminal `result` event fell past the ~512 KiB stdout capture prefix). Only the recorded metadata is reproduced here -- the real stdout bytes are not available/sanitized.

cli_005_live_failure_replay.description: Recorded metadata from the cited real invocation: exit code 0, zero stderr bytes, ~524253 stdout bytes against a ~524288-byte (512 KiB) capture limit, output_truncated true, clean managed-process completion (zero remaining processes), and no terminal `result` event present in the retained prefix. Note stdout_bytes (524253) sits just UNDER the capture_limit_bytes (524288) -- itself evidence of the pre-fix _StreamPump root-cause bug, where byte_count freezes near (not at, and never above) the cap once truncation begins instead of tracking the true uncapped total; the real total emitted by the process was almost certainly larger and simply went uncounted. Old classification was reported as 'malformed'; corrected classification must be transport_output_truncated (not malformed, not a generic transport_parse_error) because a terminal event was never independently preserved.
